linkedin.title: Most news algorithms get it wrong because they mistake clicks for interest.
linkedin.body:
We have all been there. You click on one article about a niche topic, and suddenly your feed is flooded with dozens of similar stories you never asked for. It feels like the machine is guessing, not listening. That is because most recommendation engines prioritize engagement metrics over actual reader value.

At Headlinne, we take a different approach. Instead of just tracking what you click, our engine looks at the substance of what you read. It learns your preferences by understanding the context, the depth, and the specific topics that keep you coming back. It is about building a profile that evolves as your interests shift.

Personalization should feel like a curator who knows your taste, not a billboard shouting at you. The goal is to cut through the noise of the daily news cycle and deliver only what matters to you. When the technology works, it stops feeling like an algorithm and starts feeling like a personal assistant.

Most people think space lasers are just for sci-fi movies.
beats.detail: They are actually used for science.
beats.narration: Most people think space lasers are just for sci-fi movies. They are actually powerful tools for science.

beats.caption: Japan's Hayabusa2 probe just bounced a laser off an asteroid.
beats.detail: First successful experiment of its kind.
beats.narration: But Japan's Hayabusa2 probe just pulled off the first successful laser ranging experiment on an asteroid.

beats.caption: The experiment happened while flying past the asteroid Torifune.
beats.detail: A target for the extended mission.
beats.narration: This happened while the craft was flying past Torifune, a key target for its extended mission.

beats.caption: This test proves we can measure moving space rocks with precision.
beats.narration: This test proves we can measure moving space rocks with incredible precision from great distances.

beats.caption: It is the first time any space agency has done this.
beats.narration: It is the first time any space agency has successfully performed this specific experiment.

beats.caption: This tech helps us navigate deep space more safely.
beats.narration: This kind of technology helps us navigate deep space much more safely and accurately.

story_card.headline: How to spot a dying EV battery
story_card.standfirst: You don't need to guess if your electric vehicle battery is failing.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: EV batteries do not fail all at once. They lose capacity slowly over time.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: Drivers often assume age is the main factor. Instead, battery health changes gradually.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: Recognizing subtle behavioral shifts helps you catch problems before they leave you stranded.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Pay attention to how your car performs daily. Small changes are your best early warning sign.

story_card.caption:
Knowing how to tell if your electric vehicle battery needs replacing can save you from a major headache.

Experts suggest looking for behavioral changes in your car rather than just counting the years. Since these batteries degrade slowly, staying alert to performance shifts is the smartest way to track your car's health.

Have you noticed any changes in your EV's range or performance lately?
